3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: The greenery of Brenas whizzed past the windows of the royal train as we chugged toward Mave Nortus.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: I was scheduled for a brief stop in the border town before traveling to meet Wiktor Smolak in Wraclawitz, where -- with any luck -- the Zille question would be answered at last.

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text: I was scheduled for a visit to my new intelligence hub there before traveling to meet Wiktor Smolak in Wraclawitz, where -- with any luck -- the Zille question would be answered at last.

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: Seated on a leather divan in my private salon carriage, I looked once more at the Amended Zille Agreement. Letters and numbers swam before my eyes.

13.speaker: Narrator
13.text: Seated on a leather divan in my private salon carriage, I looked once more at the contingency plans my councilors had suggested. Letters and numbers swam before my eyes.

14.speaker: Narrator
14.text: My head was gravitating towards the nearest cushion when the door to the carriage slid open.

16.speaker: Narrator
16.text: Pabel bowed as he entered. He gestured toward the phone hanging on the train wall.

17.speaker: Pabel Adria
17.text: "Sorry to interrupt, but Russello Montoro is trying to reach you. The operators should connect you in a few minutes."

19.speaker: Player_Romus
19.text: "It's about time. I have some questions for him."

22.speaker: Pabel Adria
22.text: "I did tell him your time was very limited."

23.speaker: Pabel Adria
23.text: "You'll have to make it quick, I'm afraid. We're reaching Mave Nortus shortly."

28.speaker: Pabel Adria
28.text: "I must admit I'm curious what the man has to say for himself."

35.speaker: Narrator
35.text: Pabel smiled sympathetically as he entered. He gestured toward the phone hanging on the train wall.

39.speaker: Narrator
39.text: The train lurched forward, catapulting us into each other.

43.speaker: Narrator
43.text: He immediately took a step back and brushed himself off.

44.speaker: Narrator
44.text: He used the opportunity to sneak a quick kiss, then reluctantly pulled away.

45.speaker: Pabel Adria
45.text: "A close one, Your Majesty. If anyone had seen us, they might have thought something illegal was afoot."

47.speaker: Narrator
47.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_Together"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Homosexuality_Banned"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_OutedToPlayer"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel"] > 0))

50.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
50.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Homosexuality_Banned"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_OutedToPlayer"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel"] > 0)) == false

51.speaker: Pabel Adria
51.text: "I never got a chance to thank you, Your Majesty. For... everything."

52.speaker: Pabel Adria
52.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_Together"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Homosexuality_Banned"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_OutedToPlayer"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel"] > 0)) == false)

53.speaker: Narrator
53.text: As Pabel shut the carriage door, the phone began to ring.

57.speaker: Player_Romus
57.text: "Are you scared of what the Lespians will do to you now that you're no longer an asset?"

59.speaker: Russello Montoro
59.text: "I'm warning you, Your Majesty. This could get bad."

64.speaker: Player_Romus
64.text: "I am fully aware of the gravity of the situation."

65.speaker: Player_Romus
65.text: "Sotelato is little more than a mosquito whining in my ear. I'll swat him before he becomes a menace."

66.speaker: Russello Montoro
66.text: "One of *my" former miners goes rogue and starts making open threats against the monarchy, and you say it doesn't concern me?"

68.speaker: Player_Romus
68.text: "For your information, I don't have anything against Mr. Sotelato or his party."

69.speaker: Player_Romus
69.text: "Enough with your warnings. Adarfo and his movement don't concern you."

71.speaker: Russello Montoro
71.text: "He's the face of the Rizian People's Party. He's a menace already."

73.speaker: Russello Montoro
73.text: "Really? Because it seems like he's got a bone to pick with you."

74.speaker: Russello Montoro
74.text: "Would that plan happen to involve compromising with Sotelato and his party? If so, big mistake."

75.speaker: Narrator
75.text: There was a burst of static on his end of the line.

76.speaker: Russello Montoro
76.text: "You know that 'promotion' we were talking about a while back? Forget it. I don't need it."
76.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_PromisedGovPosition"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Speaker_Adarfo"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_LoanAmount"] > 0) == false)

80.speaker: Russello Montoro
80.text: "There was a time I thought you and I were on the same page. That time's up."
80.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_PromisedGovPosition"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_Allied"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Speaker_Adarfo"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_LoanAmount"] > 0) == false)

87.speaker: Russello Montoro
87.text: "You know that stake you sold me in Rizian Oil and Gas? You can have it back. I don't need it."
87.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_PromisedGovPosition"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_Allied"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_GrantROGStake"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Speaker_Adarfo"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_LoanAmount"] > 0) == false)

88.speaker: Russello Montoro
88.text: "The Royal Family's been very good to me. But I think our time together is coming to an end."
88.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_PromisedGovPosition"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_Allied"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_GrantROGStake"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Speaker_Adarfo"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_LoanAmount"] > 0) == false)

89.speaker: Player_Romus
89.text: "I am not going to stand for this any longer. I'm nationalizing RRG. I don't care what it costs me."

90.speaker: Russello Montoro
90.text: "You want RRG? You can have it. What's left of it."

91.speaker: Player_Romus
91.text: "Enough. I'm instructing the Rizia Imperii authorities to put you under arrest immediately."

93.speaker: Russello Montoro
93.text: "You think I'm still in Rizia Imperii? Cute."

94.speaker: Player_Romus
94.text: "Let's talk about this. Even if Sotelato takes power, that doesn't automatically mean the end of you or your company."

95.speaker: Player_Romus
95.text: "You wouldn't leave Rizia. You'd lose everything."

96.speaker: Russello Montoro
96.text: "You kidding? He's got a shiny little guillotine waiting for me, right next to yours."

97.speaker: Russello Montoro
97.text: "It's been nice knowing you, Your Majesty. A real pleasure."

98.speaker: Russello Montoro
98.text: "Hm. I don't seem to be missing anything at present."

100.speaker: Russello Montoro
100.text: "I never even got a chance to congratulate you on Her Highness' engagement. Bet you're one proud papa."

109.speaker: Russello Montoro
109.text: "Heard you're off to Zille? Can't wait to see what state our mines are in."

116.speaker: Player_Romus
116.text: "You must've read the headlines. Rizia is on the brink of victory."

117.speaker: Player_Romus
117.text: "You must've read the headlines. It's a total disgrace."

118.speaker: Player_Romus
118.text: "That is between me and the head of our military."

121.speaker: Russello Montoro
121.text: "Great. Can't wait for that peacetime prosperity."

122.speaker: Russello Montoro
122.text: "Nothing but respect for General Taddeus. From death's door to bossing troops around in record time."

127.speaker: Russello Montoro
127.text: "I can't say I'm too happy about the state of the economy."

131.speaker: Russello Montoro
131.text: "I'm very glad the economy's perking up. Puts a spring in one's step."
131.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_NewBusiness_Collapse"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_NewBusiness_Reduction"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_NewBusiness_MassiveRise"] == true)

132.speaker: Russello Montoro
132.text: "Business could be better, but I can't complain."
132.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_NewBusiness_Collapse"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_NewBusiness_Reduction"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_NewBusiness_MassiveRise"] == true) == false)

133.speaker: Player_Romus
133.text: "You received your invitation for the royal wedding, didn't you? Everyone's going to be there."

137.speaker: Player_Romus
137.text: "I am proud of what my daughter's union will accomplish for our kingdom."

138.speaker: Player_Romus
138.text: "My daughter's marrying the love of her life. I am proud I let her choose her own future."

141.speaker: Player_Romus
141.text: "I'll give you a tour as soon as I can."

142.speaker: Player_Romus
142.text: "I'll pass your well wishes on to the Princess."

144.speaker: Player_Romus
144.text: "I'd be proud of my daughter whether she was engaged or not."

145.speaker: Russello Montoro
145.text: "Still, must be a real load off, right?"

146.speaker: Russello Montoro
146.text: "I've already ordered my new tuxedo. Brown, so nobody notices when I spill soup on it."

148.speaker: Player_Romus
148.text: "You got your compensation. You have nothing to complain about."

152.speaker: Player_Romus
152.text: "It doesn't matter, does it? We have Aureus."

156.speaker: Russello Montoro
156.text: "Wehzeks went crazy up there, did they? Ah, can't blame them."

157.speaker: Player_Romus
157.text: "Let's skip to the part where you tell me why you're calling."

158.speaker: Player_Romus
158.text: "A temporary setback. We've all had to make sacrifices to defeat the Palesians."

159.speaker: Player_Romus
159.text: "Rizia will bounce back. We always have."

160.speaker: Player_Romus
160.text: "Numbers are misleading. We are doing better than ever."

164.speaker: Player_Romus
164.text: "Who cares about the state of the economy? What matters is that citizen welfare is better than ever."

165.speaker: Russello Montoro
165.text: "And transform one of the most resource-rich countries in South Merkopa into a full-blown Malenyevist republic? Are you kidding?"

166.speaker: Player_Romus
166.text: "Are you talking about Lespia and ATO? Because one would think they're itching for him to overthrow me."

167.speaker: Player_Romus
167.text: "Well, what are you waiting for? Tell them to get to it."

169.speaker: Player_Romus
169.text: "I hope you're speaking metaphorically. Killing Sotelato will only turn him into a martyr and strengthen his movement."

171.speaker: Russello Montoro
171.text: "You know how these 'movements' really are. 10 percent ideas, 90 percent personality cults."

172.speaker: Russello Montoro
172.text: "The boys from Palantor have been getting bored guarding my palace. Saying it's about time they saw some real action."

173.speaker: Player_Romus
173.text: "I already have Rizia's internal security forces observing Sotelato and his followers. If the movement grows too large, we will crush it."

177.speaker: Player_Romus
177.text: "And you think they can get the job done without attracting notice?"

178.speaker: Russello Montoro
178.text: "Are you kidding? You've met 'em. They're pros."

179.speaker: Russello Montoro
179.text: "People are paying attention to Sotelato now because he's House Speaker. You take away that platform, his influence goes with it."

183.speaker: Russello Montoro
183.text: "People are paying attention to Sotelato now because he's the Delegate opposition leader. You take away that platform, his influence goes with it."

184.speaker: Russello Montoro
184.text: "I do have one other idea. See, I was thinking..."

185.speaker: Player_Romus
185.text: "I have been thinking about doing away with the House of Delegates anyway. It is a useless, redundant organ, much like an appendix or a third nipple."

186.speaker: Russello Montoro
186.text: "A weirdly specific example. But I agree."

187.speaker: Player_Romus
187.text: "The House of Delegates is a fine institution. I just don't believe a radical like Sotelato belongs there."

191.speaker: Player_Romus
191.text: "The entire notion of Delegates is blasphemous. There is but one delegate that matters, and it is I, the monarch, appointed by God as His sole delegate in Rizia."

194.speaker: Player_Romus
194.text: "That's ridiculous. Getting rid of Rizia's last semblance of democracy will rile the radicals up even further."

195.speaker: Russello Montoro
195.text: "Maybe. But they'll have a harder time finding followers."

196.speaker: Russello Montoro
196.text: "Great. Just making sure you're on the case."

197.speaker: Player_Romus
197.text: "A covert assassination that can be pinned on Sotelato's Arcasian enemies... I have to say, I like it."

199.speaker: Russello Montoro
199.text: "Should you need my guys for some other purpose, I'm happy to loan 'em out anytime."

200.speaker: Player_Romus
200.text: "Thank you. I haven't forgotten about what I promised you."

204.speaker: Player_Romus
204.text: "Thank you. I haven't forgotten about what you requested."

205.speaker: Russello Montoro
205.text: "If that's what you think, I suggest we neatly and quietly remove him from it."

206.speaker: Player_Romus
206.text: "Still, what you're suggesting strikes me as too extreme of a measure."

207.speaker: Russello Montoro
207.text: "Look, you and I have had our differences. But I think it's fair to say Sotelato is a common enemy."

210.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
210.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllIndustries"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_LaborHandsLegalized"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_Nationalization"] == true) == false

211.speaker: Russello Montoro
211.text: "I know you're no Malenyevist. It's fair to say Sotelato is a common enemy."
211.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllIndustries"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_LaborHandsLegalized"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_Nationalization"] == true) == false

212.speaker: Russello Montoro
212.text: "Some people will get mad. But with no one to lead them, how much harm can they do?"

213.speaker: Player_Romus
213.text: "I'm of the same opinion. But I don't want to involve international interests in our domestic affairs."

214.speaker: Russello Montoro
214.text: "We wouldn't need to reach outside the country, strictly speaking..."

215.speaker: Player_Romus
215.text: "I can tell you for a fact that's not going to happen. Sotelato may be against the monarchy, but the Crown will protect him and his right to free speech if we have to."

216.speaker: Russello Montoro
216.text: "I was afraid you might say that."

217.speaker: Russello Montoro
217.text: "I for one am not going to stick around and wait for him to use it."

222.speaker: Russello Montoro
222.text: "Are you still planning on working with the reformists, now that they've fallen in line behind this guy?"

223.speaker: Russello Montoro
223.text: "You're not planning on working with this guy, are you?"

227.speaker: Player_Romus
227.text: "As a matter of fact, I am. I'm fully on board with his vision for reform in Rizia, and we will work together to put it in place."

228.speaker: Player_Romus
228.text: "I don't see any other choice. His movement is too strong."

229.speaker: Player_Romus
229.text: "I told Manus Sazon I'd work with him. But I'm having second thoughts."
229.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_TalkToAdarfo_AskedManus"] == true)

230.speaker: Player_Romus
230.text: "I wouldn't tell you if I was."

235.speaker: Player_Romus
235.text: "We'll see after I meet with him."

236.speaker: Russello Montoro
236.text: "Meet with him? You'd actually give that commie the time of day?"

238.speaker: Player_Romus
238.text: "No. I am working with Grand Wiseman Ignacius to bring God to this kingdom at last. Heathens such as Sotelato will tremble before us."
238.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_TalkToAdarfo_AskedManus"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Religion_Leaning_Theocratic"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true)

242.speaker: Russello Montoro
242.text: "Huh. Well, as long as you protect the sanctity of Rizian resources and the corporations that extract them, I'm on board."

244.speaker: Russello Montoro
244.text: "Well, if you are, you should reconsider."

245.speaker: Russello Montoro
245.text: "Let me guess. Sazon told you that? Kid always did have a weak spine."

246.speaker: Russello Montoro
246.text: "You'll have to exercise a hell of a lot of authority to shut down the monster your dad created. But with RRG's help, it'll be easy."

248.speaker: Player_Romus
248.text: "And what do you want in exchange?"

250.speaker: Player_Romus
250.text: "I don't need your help. As King of Rizia, I could shutter the House of Delegates at any time."

255.speaker: Russello Montoro
255.text: "Although I am still holding you to your promise. Whatever new government you have, I want a say in it."

256.speaker: Russello Montoro
256.text: "Although if you were to be so kind as to offer me a spot in government once the dust settles, I'd be much obliged."

257.speaker: Russello Montoro
257.text: "Good luck getting the nobles on board with that. Even with the RPP majority, a lot of them have gotten used to their cushy Delegate seats."

261.speaker: Russello Montoro
261.text: "Good luck getting the nobles on board with that. A lot of them have gotten used to their cushy Delegate seats."

262.speaker: Russello Montoro
262.text: "With my connections, I can make sure they're well compensated for their sudden unemployment."

263.speaker: Russello Montoro
263.text: "With my connections, I can make sure the nobles who hold Delegate seats are compensated for their sudden unemployment."

264.speaker: Russello Montoro
264.text: "And in the case any RPP members start feeling litigious, they'll find every legal expert in the kingdom mysteriously occupied."

265.speaker: Player_Romus
265.text: "Shutting down the House of Delegates is a prudent move under the current circumstances, and your assistance would be much appreciated."

266.speaker: Player_Romus
266.text: "I firmly believe this is not the way to deal with the opposition. Thank you for calling me nonetheless."

267.speaker: Player_Romus
267.text: "If I shut down the House of Delegates, it will be of my own volition, with my own resources."

268.speaker: Player_Romus
268.text: "On second thought, it seems much less complicated to remove Sotelato as a threat."

270.speaker: Player_Romus
270.text: "I can take care of my own affairs without having to rely on some Arcasian thugs."

273.speaker: Player_Romus
273.text: "And what will you want in return for this act of largesse?"

274.speaker: Russello Montoro
274.text: "Oh, nothing, Your Majesty. This is a win-win-win situation we're talking about."

275.speaker: Player_Romus
275.text: "An Arcasian PMC at my beck and call? Yes, please."

279.speaker: Russello Montoro
279.text: "'Course, I still expect you to honor that promise you made to me a while back."

280.speaker: Russello Montoro
280.text: "'Course, I do hope you'll remember that one request I made a while back."

281.speaker: Russello Montoro
281.text: "Elena isn't getting any younger. And a world of opportunities await."

283.speaker: Narrator
283.text: Static from the train telephone hissed in my ear as he hung up.

284.speaker: Russello Montoro
284.text: "I won't tell Antoine you called him that."

286.speaker: Russello Montoro
286.text: "I wouldn't be calling you if this wasn't serious. I trust you to handle it."

290.speaker: Russello Montoro
290.text: "Don't get the wrong idea, I'm a peaceful man. But this will save you, me and Rizia a whole lot of grief down the line."

291.speaker: Russello Montoro
291.text: "Listen, I don't like the idea either. But sometimes a nice, clean hit can save you a whole lot of messiness down the line."

292.speaker: Russello Montoro
292.text: "Anyway. I trust you know what you're doing."

296.speaker: Russello Montoro
296.text: "'Course, I still expect you to honor that promise you made to me a while back."

297.speaker: Russello Montoro
297.text: "'Course, I do hope you'll remember that request I made a while back."

298.speaker: Player_Romus
298.text: "When the time comes, I will honor it. You will take your place in the Rizian government."

299.speaker: Player_Romus
299.text: "How soon could they get it done?"

301.speaker: Russello Montoro
301.text: "Should you be satisfied with their services, I'd be happy to loan them out for other occasions."

304.speaker: Player_Romus
304.text: "Let's deal with the Sotelato problem first. Then I'll think about your request."

306.speaker: Player_Romus
306.text: "I will find another way to deal with Adarfo and his band of miscreants. But I'll keep Palantor in mind for other... assignments."

308.speaker: Player_Romus
308.text: "Thank you for your offer. But my answer is no. Palantor won't get involved in Crown affairs."

312.speaker: Russello Montoro
312.text: "True, true. Your maneuvering in Pales has made us both rich men. Rich-er."

313.speaker: Russello Montoro
313.text: "Can't wait to see the RRG logo flying over that land again."

315.speaker: Player_Romus
315.text: "Let me guess. You think you could do better if you were in charge of the economy?"

316.speaker: Russello Montoro
316.text: "All I'm saying is Rizia needs to think bigger. Remember, everyone relied on our gold back in the day."

317.speaker: Russello Montoro
317.text: "No kidding. I've had to switch from Lespian caviar to Lachaven salmon roe. You know how much of a downgrade that is?"

318.speaker: Russello Montoro
318.text: "To heck with bouncing back. We should be bouncing higher."

322.speaker: Player_Romus
322.text: "I've just given the orders to infuse a massive amount of government money into the economy. We'll bounce back in no time."

324.speaker: Russello Montoro
324.text: "That's great. But welfare goes down the tubes pretty fast if citizens don't have jobs."

325.speaker: Russello Montoro
325.text: "I'll have to trust you on that one."

326.speaker: Russello Montoro
326.text: "I just wanted to hear your voice, Your Majesty."

330.speaker: Russello Montoro
330.text: "Specifically, I want to hear that silky baritone of yours explain why new regulations are being imposed on my company after you promised otherwise."
330.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllIndustries"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_GrantROGStake"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == true) == false)

332.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
332.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllIndustries"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_GrantROGStake"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Floating_PDSE_RustyChairs"] == false

333.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
333.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllIndustries"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_GrantROGStake"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Floating_PDSE_RustyChairs"] == false) == false

334.speaker: Russello Montoro
334.text: "Your Majesty, our relationship, as it were, is based on a certain understanding."
334.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllIndustries"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_GrantROGStake"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Floating_PDSE_RustyChairs"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == true) == false)

335.speaker: Russello Montoro
335.text: "You leave me to do my business, I underwrite certain activities on the Crown's behalf."

336.speaker: Russello Montoro
336.text: "So tell me. What's with the sudden urge to regulate RRG?"

337.speaker: Player_Romus
337.text: "You're upset about regulations? Be glad I haven't nationalized you."

338.speaker: Player_Romus
338.text: "It's nothing against you or your company. The strikers were impeding all Rizian businesses."

342.speaker: Player_Romus
342.text: "You've got to realize what I'm up against. Rizia is perilously close to another uprising."

343.speaker: Player_Romus
343.text: "I don't understand your knee-jerk opposition to regulation. Why not embrace it as a positive development?"

344.speaker: Player_Romus
344.text: "Look at how much the Crown is spending on businesses -- including yours. You can afford to implement these."

347.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
347.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DiscussedOnYacht"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.HODElection_RustyInfluence_RPP"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_OpenToRustyInvolvement"] == true) == false

348.speaker: Russello Montoro
348.text: "It's not the costs that upset me. It's the breach of trust."

352.speaker: Russello Montoro
352.text: "See, this is what's got me worried. Where's the trust between us?"

353.speaker: Russello Montoro
353.text: "It's not the regulations per se I'm upset about. It's the breach of trust."

354.speaker: Russello Montoro
354.text: "Still, I do feel like there's been a breach of trust."

355.speaker: Russello Montoro
355.text: "Back when we were watching football together, you told me there'd be a seat in government with my name on it."

359.speaker: Russello Montoro
359.text: "Now I'm wondering if I can trust you on that."

360.speaker: Russello Montoro
360.text: "The only thing that would reassure me, Your Majesty, is the knowledge that somewhere in the future there's a seat in government with my name on it."

361.speaker: Player_Romus
361.text: "You haven't seen anything yet. Wait till Rizian businesses put our stimulus money to work."

368.speaker: Russello Montoro
368.text: "Thanks for that. Might take a while, but you'll get results for sure."

369.speaker: Russello Montoro
369.text: "And I wanted to know if you had any hints about what the future has in store for us."
369.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_NewBusiness_MassiveRise"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_LocalGoldExtraction_High"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_GrantROGStake"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true)) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == false) == false)

373.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
373.text: Sing "I changed my mind" in a silky baritone.

375.speaker: Russello Montoro
375.text: "That's what I get for making deals with His Majesty the Cut-Up."

376.speaker: Russello Montoro
376.text: "Point is, there has been what I'd call a breach of trust."

377.speaker: Russello Montoro
377.text: "You know, I've really got no complaints with the way you've been treating me and my business."
377.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllIndustries"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_GrantROGStake"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllIndustries"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_GrantROGStake"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Floating_PDSE_RustyChairs"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == true) == false)

378.speaker: Russello Montoro
378.text: "At that football game a couple years back, it sounded like you had big plans in the works. Is that still happening?"

379.speaker: Russello Montoro
379.text: "At the football game a few years back, it seemed like you were trying to get the reformists out of your hair."
379.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DiscussedOnYacht"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.HODElection_RustyInfluence_RPP"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_OpenToRustyInvolvement"] == true) == false

383.speaker: Russello Montoro
383.text: "From what I can tell, it backfired."

384.speaker: Russello Montoro
384.text: "And from what I can tell, you did."

385.speaker: Player_Romus
385.text: "I have chosen another direction for Rizia. A holier one."

389.speaker: Player_Romus
389.text: "Reform is still our goal. We'll be making our move any day now, in fact."

390.speaker: Player_Romus
390.text: "We are still set on a new constitution for Rizia. But it will take a while."

394.speaker: Player_Romus
394.text: "My big ideas took a backseat to the war, I'm afraid."

395.speaker: Player_Romus
395.text: "It is. And when these changes happen, you'll have a front-row seat."

399.speaker: Player_Romus
399.text: "Indeed. But the holy transformation of Rizia has yet to begin."

400.speaker: Player_Romus
400.text: "Circumstances have changed. I'm now drafting reforms with Manus Sazon and the RPP."

404.speaker: Player_Romus
404.text: "The reformists are nothing to me. If they get too out of line, I'll crush them."

405.speaker: Player_Romus
405.text: "The reform movement will be swept aside once the holy transformation of Rizia begins."

410.speaker: Player_Romus
410.text: "Perhaps in the future. I have other priorities right now."

414.speaker: Russello Montoro
414.text: "Sotelato might not seem like much of a menace. But if I know my ex-employees, this could get bad."

415.speaker: Player_Romus
415.text: "I gave some thought to the idea of reform. But ultimately, I had to reject it."

416.speaker: Russello Montoro
416.text: "I see. A man's allowed to change his mind, I'll grant you that."

417.speaker: Russello Montoro
417.text: "Are you winking over there? I can't tell over the phone, Your Majesty."

421.speaker: Russello Montoro
421.text: "Our conversation did leave me with certain expectations. Are they still on track to be fulfilled?"

422.speaker: Russello Montoro
422.text: "Is that so? That's very, very interesting."

423.speaker: Player_Romus
423.text: "I never wanted the reformists 'out of my hair.' I believe they can coexist peacefully with the monarchists."

425.speaker: Russello Montoro
425.text: "Hard to crush a majority, Your Majesty. You might need help."

426.speaker: Russello Montoro
426.text: "Huh. Interesting change of direction, Your Majesty."

427.speaker: Player_Romus
427.text: "All I ever wanted was stability for my realm. We are closer than ever to achieving it."

429.speaker: Russello Montoro
429.text: "A man's allowed to change his mind, I'll grant you that."

430.speaker: Player_Romus
430.text: "There is a war going on, and you're whining to the King about a seat in government? You should feel ashamed of yourself."

434.speaker: Player_Romus
434.text: "I need all my focus to deal with President Smolak and Zille, and you come whining to me about a seat in government? You should feel ashamed of yourself."

435.speaker: Player_Romus
435.text: "I have not forgotten what I promised you. In time, your loyalty to me will be duly rewarded."

436.speaker: Player_Romus
436.text: "Stay loyal to me, and you will be rewarded. I give you my word."

437.speaker: Player_Romus
437.text: "What will you do with that seat? If I understood your motivations, you wanted to bring Rizia closer to ATO. That's never going to happen now."

441.speaker: Player_Romus
441.text: "It depends. Is your loyalty to money, or is it to the six pillars of Wruhecism, the one true religion?"

442.speaker: Narrator
442.text: I heard him clear his throat nervously.

443.speaker: Russello Montoro
443.text: "My loyalty is to my King, of course. And whatever he decides."

447.speaker: Russello Montoro
447.text: "Maybe not. But I still move in the same circles as before. Our business connections with ATO countries don't have to suffer the same fate as our diplomatic ones."

448.speaker: Player_Romus
448.text: "And what will you do with that seat? Give free reign to the Rizian oligarchy?"

449.speaker: Russello Montoro
449.text: "You and I want the same thing, Your Majesty. For Rizia to take its rightful place next to the superpowers."

453.speaker: Russello Montoro
453.text: "We should be the ones calling the shots in GRACE, you know. Not Rumburg."

454.speaker: Russello Montoro
454.text: "If we want to start calling the shots internationally, we're going to need an economy to match."

458.speaker: Russello Montoro
458.text: "If you need any help winning folks over to your side, you know who to ask."

459.speaker: Player_Romus
459.text: "There is a war going on, and you're whining to the King about your expectations? You should be ashamed of yourself."

463.speaker: Player_Romus
463.text: "I need all my focus to deal with President Smolak and Zille, and you come whining to me about your expectations? You should be ashamed of yourself."

464.speaker: Player_Romus
464.text: "You still want a seat in government? If I understood your motivations, you wanted to bring Rizia closer to ATO. That's never going to happen now."

468.speaker: Russello Montoro
468.text: "Maybe not. But I still move in the same circles as before. Our business connections with ATO countries don't have to suffer the same fate as our diplomatic ones."

469.speaker: Player_Romus
469.text: "You're still after a seat in government? Tell me, what will you do with it?"

470.speaker: Russello Montoro
470.text: "You and I want the same thing, Your Majesty. For Rizia to take its rightful place next to the superpowers."

474.speaker: Russello Montoro
474.text: "We should be the ones calling the shots in GRACE, you know. Not Rumburg."

475.speaker: Russello Montoro
475.text: "If we want to start calling the shots internationally, we're going to need an economy to match."

476.speaker: Player_Romus
476.text: "It's not that simple. In a truly democratic Rizia, the King doesn't appoint ministers."

477.speaker: Russello Montoro
477.text: "But the Prime Minster does. So let's make sure he or she is someone we like."

478.speaker: Russello Montoro
478.text: "Ashamed I was gullible enough to let the King of Rizia string me along."

479.speaker: Russello Montoro
479.text: "I am truly, deeply ashamed, Your Majesty."

480.speaker: Russello Montoro
480.text: "Sorry to disturb you. And good luck over in Wehlen."

481.speaker: Russello Montoro
481.text: "Rewarded how? I'm a little dense, so please enlighten me on the specifics."

483.speaker: Russello Montoro
483.text: "Ashamed I stuck my neck out for you without getting something upfront first."

484.speaker: Russello Montoro
484.text: "Assuming there's a role for me in all this, of course."

485.speaker: Player_Romus
485.text: "Stay loyal to me, and you will be rewarded. I promise you that."

487.speaker: Player_Romus
487.text: "I know what I promised you. But it's not going to be feasible in the current climate."

494.speaker: Player_Romus
494.text: "Your role? Rusty, I have no idea what's going to happen. Count yourself lucky if RRG emerges unscathed."

495.speaker: Russello Montoro
495.text: "Hey! You can't blame a man for getting curious."

497.speaker: Russello Montoro
497.text: "As long as you understand that our cooperation ends here."

498.speaker: Russello Montoro
498.text: "Sorry to bother you, Your Majesty. I know it's a busy day."

499.speaker: Player_Romus
499.text: "A government position is just not going to be feasible in the current climate. Sorry to disappoint you."

501.speaker: Russello Montoro
501.text: "As long as you understand that RRG won't be able to help you going forward."

502.speaker: Player_Romus
502.text: "I cannot be concrete about that right now. You'll just have to trust me."

506.speaker: Russello Montoro
506.text: "All right. I'll hold you to it that we're still on the same side."

507.speaker: Russello Montoro
507.text: "And why should I trust you, Your Majesty?"

511.speaker: Player_Romus
511.text: "You are overestimating the strength of this so-called movement. It'll fizzle out before long."

514.speaker: Player_Romus
514.text: "I'll keep your offer in mind. Thank you."

515.speaker: Player_Romus
515.text: "My reforms will be completely transparent and above board. It's the only way they'll pass."

516.speaker: Player_Romus
516.text: "Yes, I will reach out should I suddenly find myself devoid of all integrity."

517.speaker: Russello Montoro
517.text: "Funny thing about the best-laid plans, Your Majesty."

519.speaker: Russello Montoro
519.text: "Wishing you the best of luck. It can't be easy, going behind your own family's back."

520.speaker: Russello Montoro
520.text: "I'll be right here by the phone."

521.speaker: Player_Romus
521.text: "It's not the reformists I'm worried most about. It's backlash from the noble houses."

522.speaker: Russello Montoro
522.text: "Ooh, good call. If anyone's got the real power to stir up trouble, it's them."

532.speaker: Russello Montoro
532.text: "Leaves me wondering what my role will be in all this."

533.speaker: Russello Montoro
533.text: "Leaves me wondering if there's still going to be a role for me in all this."

534.speaker: Russello Montoro
534.text: "Our conversation back then did leave me with certain expectations. Are they still on track to be fulfilled?"

538.speaker: Russello Montoro
538.text: "If you need any help maintaining the natural order in this kingdom, you know who to ask."

539.speaker: Russello Montoro
539.text: "Assuming, of course, that there's a role for me in all this."

540.speaker: Russello Montoro
540.text: "Do me a favor, at least. Take a picture of old Smolak's face when he signs Zille back to us."

544.speaker: Russello Montoro
544.text: "Your Majesty. I can't thank you enough for taking my call."

545.speaker: Narrator
545.text: He tried to keep his tone light as he spoke.

546.speaker: Russello Montoro
546.text: "Uh, my guards couldn't help but notice some new faces around the periphery of my palace."

547.speaker: Russello Montoro
547.text: "You do know that I'm nothing but a humble servant of the Rizian Crown, right?"

548.speaker: Player_Romus
548.text: "Alvarez told me everything. Your secret is out."

550.speaker: Player_Romus
550.text: "Give me one reason why I shouldn't have you thrown in jail."

551.speaker: Player_Romus
551.text: "I thought so once. Now I don't know what to believe."

555.speaker: Player_Romus
555.text: "Come on, Rusty. We've never liked each other. But I had no idea how deep your treachery ran."

561.speaker: Narrator
561.text: There was a loud burst of static as we passed through a tunnel. I strained to hear what Rusty was saying.

562.speaker: Russello Montoro
562.text: "...I don't know what you've heard from whom, but I'm on your side."

563.speaker: Russello Montoro
563.text: "Let me prove it to you. I've got secrets they wouldn't want getting out."

564.speaker: Player_Romus
564.text: "Before we continue, you need to tell me everything about your cooperation with Lespia."

566.speaker: Player_Romus
566.text: "You and your company are mine now, to do with as I wish. Is that clear?"

570.speaker: Russello Montoro
570.text: "I wouldn't call it a cooperation. And my contact wasn't even Lespian..."

572.speaker: Russello Montoro
572.text: "But fine. I will grant to you that my meteoric rise at RRG was not accomplished entirely on my lonesome."

573.speaker: Russello Montoro
573.text: "In exchange, I have occasionally allowed RRG to serve as a financial conduit between those partners and... various other parties."

574.speaker: Russello Montoro
574.text: "Early on in my career, certain international partners took note of my ambitions and offered their assistance."

575.speaker: Player_Romus
575.text: "Do you still have records of those transactions? Your life depends on this, Mr. Montoro."

576.speaker: Player_Romus
576.text: "We know all that already. Did you know Lespia was trying to undermine us?"

577.speaker: Russello Montoro
577.text: "Let me tell you a secret. I made backup copies of all the paperwork. Not even my guards know where they're kept."

578.speaker: Narrator
578.text: There was a tinge of desperation to his voice.

579.speaker: Russello Montoro
579.text: "In the spirit of honesty, I will grant to you that my meteoric rise at RRG was not accomplished entirely on my lonesome."

580.speaker: Russello Montoro
580.text: "But please just listen to me first."

581.speaker: Player_Romus
581.text: "Were you complicit in the Friendship Day bombing? Because if you were, lives are on your hands."

582.speaker: Russello Montoro
582.text: "I swear I had no idea what I was transferring to whom. It was shell corporations inside shell corporations..."

583.speaker: Russello Montoro
583.text: "But let me tell you a secret. I made backup copies of all the paperwork. It's all there for someone smarter than me to decipher."

584.speaker: Russello Montoro
584.text: "I swear I had no idea. It was shell corporations on top of shell corporations..."

585.speaker: Player_Romus
585.text: "I destroyed the evidence I had against Lespia as a favor to Prime Minister Alvarez. I'm not looking to incriminate our neighbors."

586.speaker: Player_Romus
586.text: "I order you to hand over this information."

587.speaker: Russello Montoro
587.text: "I wish I could, Your Majesty. But I can't just saunter out of my house and deliver it to you."

589.speaker: Russello Montoro
589.text: "Then let me help you out some other way."

590.speaker: Russello Montoro
590.text: "We sweep this whole business under the rug, and I'll still have money and influence to spare. I can push anyone in any direction you want. Off a cliff, if that's your thing."

591.speaker: Russello Montoro
591.text: "About half of my guards from Palantor are guys I trust. The others, well... I don't think they ever worked for me."

592.speaker: Player_Romus
592.text: "If I ensure your protection, will you be able to get me these files?"

593.speaker: Russello Montoro
593.text: "Yes. But I'll have to be damn well protected."

594.speaker: Player_Romus
594.text: "This is what you get for betraying your kingdom. You deserve whatever punishment the Lespians can dream up."

595.speaker: Player_Romus
595.text: "The Crown can afford to protect you. But you still haven't convinced me why I should."

602.speaker: Player_Romus
602.text: "The Crown has the manpower to protect you. But you still haven't convinced me why I should."

603.speaker: Player_Romus
603.text: "Unfortunately, the Crown has neither the budget nor the available manpower to protect you."

604.speaker: Russello Montoro
604.text: "If I do this for you, there's no way they're letting me live. You've got to provide me with reinforcements."

606.speaker: Russello Montoro
606.text: "Because it'd put Zille in your hands."

607.speaker: Player_Romus
607.text: "I'll do whatever I have to. If you have evidence Lespia was plotting against Rizia and Wehlen, we have to take it to the world stage."

608.speaker: Russello Montoro
608.text: "And if you leave my name out of these... revelations, I'll still have power and influence to spare."

609.speaker: Russello Montoro
609.text: "Please, Your Majesty. This would put Zille in your hands."

610.speaker: Russello Montoro
610.text: "I'll help you, Your Majesty. Zille is practically yours already."

611.speaker: Russello Montoro
611.text: "I know our plans for the House of Delegates election didn't pan out. But that wasn't my fault."
611.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_Allied"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HODElection_RustyInfluence_RNC"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_Allied"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HODElection_RustyInfluence_RNC"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_Allied"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HODElection_RustyInfluence_RPP"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false)

621.speaker: Russello Montoro
621.text: "Our plans to shut the reformists out of the House of Delegates worked out, didn't they?"
621.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_Allied"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HODElection_RustyInfluence_RNC"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false)

625.speaker: Russello Montoro
625.text: "Our plans to get the reformists a majority in the House of Delegates worked out, didn't they?"
625.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_Allied"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HODElection_RustyInfluence_RNC"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_Allied"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HODElection_RustyInfluence_RPP"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true)

629.speaker: Russello Montoro
629.text: "I've been telling you all along how useful RRG can be to you."
629.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_Allied"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HODElection_RustyInfluence_RNC"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_Allied"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HODElection_RustyInfluence_RPP"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_Allied"] == true)

630.speaker: Russello Montoro
630.text: "Whatever differences you and I have had in the past? Water under the bridge."
630.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_Allied"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HODElection_RustyInfluence_RNC"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_Allied"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HODElection_RustyInfluence_RPP"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_Allied"] == true) == false)

631.speaker: Player_Romus
631.text: "Let me confess something to you. I never had any intention of letting you off the hook for your crimes. I just called to hear you grovel."

632.speaker: Player_Romus
632.text: "All I want is to hold Lespia to account. Once that's done, our business is finished as far as I'm concerned."

637.speaker: Player_Romus
637.text: "Get me the evidence you have against Lespia, and the Crown will make sure you don't face punishment."

638.speaker: Russello Montoro
638.text: "Also perfectly fine, Your Majesty. Whatever you want."

642.speaker: Player_Romus
642.text: "You will not be arrested for now, nor do I want your evidence against Lespia. Just remember your King's benevolence, Rusty."

643.speaker: Player_Romus
643.text: "You can walk free. As long as you allow the Crown to use Palantor for its own purposes."

644.speaker: Player_Romus
644.text: "Are you serious? You've committed a betrayal of the highest order. Consider yourself under arrest."

645.speaker: Russello Montoro
645.text: "I think the connection just broke off. What'd you just say?"

646.speaker: Player_Romus
646.text: "Our security forces have your palace surrounded. I'd advise you not to put up a fight."

647.speaker: Player_Romus
647.text: "You wanted protection? No place is more secure than jail."

649.speaker: Player_Romus
649.text: "You heard me. The King has spoken."

650.speaker: Narrator
650.text: I pushed the button to disconnect the line.

651.speaker: Russello Montoro
651.text: "Y-yes, Your Majesty. The boys are all yours."

652.speaker: Russello Montoro
652.text: "I-- I will, Your Majesty. Call me if you need anything."

654.speaker: Player_Romus
654.text: "I wish I could say yes. But as long as you're still in charge of RRG, you are a security liability."

655.speaker: Russello Montoro
655.text: "And the protection I was asking about?"

656.speaker: Player_Romus
656.text: "The Crown will spare no expense in contracting a new guard force for you." [-1 Budget]

657.speaker: Player_Romus
657.text: "We'll send troops at once to guarantee your safety." [-200 Manpower]

666.speaker: Russello Montoro
666.text: "Thank you so much, Your Majesty. I promise you I'll deliver."

675.speaker: Narrator
675.text: Still holding the receiver, I dialed Lucita and told her to proceed with Rusty Montoro's arrest.

676.speaker: Narrator
676.text: Still holding the receiver, I dialed Titus and told him to proceed with Rusty Montoro's arrest.

677.speaker: Narrator
677.text: Still holding the receiver, I dialed Taddeus and told him to proceed with Rusty Montoro's arrest.

680.speaker: Player_Romus
680.text: "Don't mess this up. I am counting on you."

688.speaker: Narrator
688.text: I pushed the button to disconnect the line.

696.speaker: Narrator
696.text: Still holding the receiver, I dialed Lucita and ordered her to place Russello Montoro under special protection.

697.speaker: Narrator
697.text: Still holding the receiver, I dialed Titus and ordered him to place Russello Montoro under special protection.

698.speaker: Narrator
698.text: Still holding the receiver, I dialed Taddeus and ordered him to place Russello Montoro under special protection.

702.speaker: Player_Romus
702.text: "Not currently, but I may find myself forced to compromise with him in the future."

703.speaker: Russello Montoro
703.text: "I thought you knew these types. Compromise ain't their style."

711.speaker: Russello Montoro
711.text: "We'd have to be crafty about it. But if you and I work together, get him in the right place at the right time..."

716.speaker: Narrator
716.text: The train chugged onwards. Zille was within our sights.

724.speaker: Player_Romus
724.text: "Don't play dumb with me. Your secret is out."

729.speaker: Player_Romus
729.text: "I need something more concrete than that. Do you have proof Lespia was trying to sabotage our energy infrastructure?"

732.speaker: Russello Montoro
732.text: "Remember that little incident in Wehlen? Well, I'm pretty sure you-know-who was behind it."

733.speaker: Player_Romus
733.text: "You wouldn't know that unless *you* were behind it as well."

734.speaker: Player_Romus
734.text: "Lespia organized the Friendship Day bombing? I'm going to need some cold, hard evidence before I believe you."

735.speaker: Player_Romus
735.text: "We've already found and arrested the responsible party, Rusty. Case closed."

739.speaker: Russello Montoro
739.text: "Right. But see, are you *sure* they're the ones responsible? I've got paperwork that says otherwise."

740.speaker: Player_Romus
740.text: "We stopped that investigation, Rusty. Case closed."

741.speaker: Russello Montoro
741.text: "Hey, I had no idea what I was doing at the time. Shell corporations inside of shell corporations and all that..."

742.speaker: Russello Montoro
742.text: "But I knew enough to make backup copies of the paperwork. It's all there for someone smarter than me to decipher."

743.speaker: Russello Montoro
743.text: "And I've got exactly that. I think."

744.speaker: Russello Montoro
744.text: "I was dealing with shell corporations inside shell corporations... but the paperwork's all there, for someone smarter than me to decipher."

745.speaker: Russello Montoro
745.text: "...I think. Can't make heads or tails of it myself, but it's all there for someone smarter than me to decipher."

746.speaker: Russello Montoro
746.text: "Right. Except I've got paperwork that says otherwise."

747.speaker: Narrator
747.text: There was a tinge of desperation to his voice.

748.speaker: Player_Romus
748.text: "Are you scared of what the Lespians will do to you if they find out we've blown your cover?"

749.speaker: Player_Romus
749.text: "I said, case closed. I'm not interested in discussing this further."

750.speaker: Narrator
750.text: There was a tinge of desperation to his voice.

756.speaker: Player_Romus
756.text: "I think you're bluffing. Now that Lespia's blown your cover, you're a dead man walking."

757.speaker: Player_Romus
757.text: "What about Palantor? Having a mercenary force that's not connected to the Crown in any way could be quite useful to me in the future."

758.speaker: Russello Montoro
758.text: "Sure, we can do that, as long as you and I stay on the good side of the Western powers-that-be."

759.speaker: Russello Montoro
759.text: "Meaning all that talk about incriminating Lespia has to go out the window."

760.speaker: Russello Montoro
760.text: "Does... does that mean I'm off the hook?"

761.speaker: Russello Montoro
761.text: "Come on. What's Lespia going to do to me? My fate's in your hands, not theirs."

762.speaker: Player_Romus
762.text: "The only thing that's of use to me is your business. And I can have that without you."

766.speaker: Player_Romus
766.text: "I've decided I want to go after Lespia after all. Get me evidence against Alvarez, and I'll make sure you don't face punishment."

767.speaker: Russello Montoro
767.text: "All well and good, Your Majesty, but I'm going to need your help to keep the Lespians from coming after me."

769.speaker: Narrator
769.text: My agreement with Alvarez meant nothing. Lespia would answer for its crimes.

770.speaker: Russello Montoro
770.text: "There's still time to turn this around. I believe in us."

771.speaker: Russello Montoro
771.text: "Listen. I'm calling because I want to know what you think about a certain rising star in the Rizian parliament."

772.speaker: Player_Romus
772.text: "I am continuing with my reform plans. Manus Sazon and I will make sure there is a place for you in the new government."

773.speaker: Player_Romus
773.text: "My kingdom of God will still need a financial policy. When the time comes, I will elevate you to your rightful place."
773.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Religion_Leaning_Theocratic"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true)

774.speaker: Player_Romus
774.text: "Petition for treasurer during the next round of council appointments. I will make sure you get the position."

775.speaker: Russello Montoro
775.text: "That's all I ever wanted, Your Majesty. I can't wait."

785.speaker: Russello Montoro
785.text: "I'm sure you know that a number of folks out there would very much like to see Sotelato dead and buried. And I don't just mean Rizians."

790.speaker: Russello Montoro
790.text: "They might revel in the instability for a moment, but ultimately, Sotelato's a problem for them. One with an easy solution."

794.speaker: Narrator
794.text: There was a burst of static on his end of the line.

799.speaker: Player_Romus
799.text: "What you've just implied is grounds for arrest. Give me one reason why I shouldn't put you behind bars right now."

800.speaker: Narrator
800.text: There was a burst of static on his end of the line.

801.speaker: Russello Montoro
801.text: "Huh... You know, I can't actually think of one."

805.speaker: Russello Montoro
805.text: "But just so you know, if you plan on reforming the country with his involvement, I'm out."

806.speaker: Player_Romus
806.text: "That seems like an extreme measure. Nobody's even listening to him."

807.speaker: Russello Montoro
807.text: "Yeah, okay. Maybe you're right. That said..."

808.speaker: Player_Romus
808.text: "I agree that the Sotelato threat must be neutralized. But I don't want to resort to the means you're hinting at."

812.speaker: Russello Montoro
812.text: "And as for that money you owe me... consider your debt repaid."

817.speaker: Russello Montoro
817.text: "You know that money you owe me? Consider that debt squared."

818.speaker: Russello Montoro
818.text: "But should the Crown need assistance keeping his movement in check, I'm counting on you to reach out."

822.speaker: Player_Romus
822.text: "Very well. I don't need your help anyway."

823.speaker: Player_Romus
823.text: "That's very kind of you. I'll remember your words."

825.speaker: Player_Romus
825.text: "Enough of this talk. You and I have a business partnership. That's it."

826.speaker: Player_Romus
826.text: "I'll deal with him on my own. Don't worry about it."

831.speaker: Russello Montoro
831.text: "On that note, I'm still expecting prompt repayment of the money you owe me."

834.speaker: Russello Montoro
834.text: "I wouldn't be calling you if this wasn't serious. I trust you to handle it."

838.speaker: Russello Montoro
838.text: "Huh. My company has a ledger that says otherwise."

840.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

842.speaker: Russello Montoro
842.text: "And I wanted to offer up a piece of information that'll come in extremely handy in your upcoming negotiations with Wehlen."
842.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_NewBusiness_MassiveRise"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_LocalGoldExtraction_High"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_GrantROGStake"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true)) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == false)

848.speaker: Russello Montoro
848.text: "But you did leave me with certain expectations. And now I'm wondering how exactly you plan on fulfilling them."

852.speaker: Russello Montoro
852.text: "But it does leave me wondering what my role will be in all this."

856.speaker: Russello Montoro
856.text: "Especially a man who's lent His Majesty many a guilder over the year."

860.speaker: Russello Montoro
860.text: "Not to mention all that money I lent you..."

861.speaker: Player_Romus
861.text: "I've had it with your insolence. If you know what's good for you, you'll hang up now."

866.speaker: Russello Montoro
866.text: "Rewarded how, Your Majesty? You'll forgive me if I'm a little dense."

868.speaker: Player_Romus
868.text: "I'll tell you what. Continue to be useful to me, and I'll make sure Manus Sazon grants you a cabinet position."

869.speaker: Player_Romus
869.text: "I'll tell you what. Continue to be useful to me, and I'll grant you a seat on my council. Just submit your petition when the time comes."

873.speaker: Player_Romus
873.text: "My kingdom of God will still need a financial policy. When the time comes, I will elevate you to your rightful place."

875.speaker: Russello Montoro
875.text: "Now we're talking! It's a done deal."

876.speaker: Player_Romus
876.text: "Listen, I remember the promise I made to you back then. But I can't guarantee it'll happen."

880.speaker: Player_Romus
880.text: "I never promised you anything, and I'm not about to start now. Be happy with what you've got."

881.speaker: Russello Montoro
881.text: "Alright, alright. I won't push my luck."

882.speaker: Russello Montoro
882.text: "Hmm. So the King of Rizia isn't a man of his word?"

883.speaker: Russello Montoro
883.text: "I won't hold it against you, Your Majesty. But don't expect any special favors from RRG in the future."

886.speaker: Russello Montoro
886.text: "Alright, alright. I won't push my luck."

887.speaker: Russello Montoro
887.text: "Now that that's settled... is there anything I can do to make both our dreams come true?"

891.speaker: Russello Montoro
891.text: "I know for a fact you're going to have a tough time getting any reforms past the noble houses."

902.speaker: Russello Montoro
902.text: "Specifically, I want to hear your opinion on a certain rising star in the Rizian parliament."

904.speaker: Russello Montoro
904.text: "But as it happens, Antoine and the boys of Palantor are specially trained in the art of persuasion."

905.speaker: Russello Montoro
905.text: "I've got the boys of Palantor at my beck and call. Happy to lend them out for any projects too dirty for your Golden Guard to touch."

906.speaker: Player_Romus
906.text: "Good to know. There may come a time when I am forced to eliminate my rivals."

908.speaker: Player_Romus
908.text: "What kind of a king do you take me for? I would never stoop that low."

909.speaker: Player_Romus
909.text: "The House of Delegates has been getting in my way of late. Can Palantor assist me in doing away with it?"

916.speaker: Player_Romus
916.text: "Just keep lending me money when I need it. That's all I ask."

917.speaker: Russello Montoro
917.text: "The bank of Rusty is always open."

918.speaker: Player_Romus
918.text: "On second thought, that seems like overkill."

919.speaker: Russello Montoro
919.text: "With my connections, I can make sure the nobles who hold Delegate seats are compensated for their sudden unemployment."

920.speaker: Russello Montoro
920.text: "And in the case any RPP members start feeling litigious, they'll find every legal expert in the kingdom mysteriously occupied."

921.speaker: Player_Romus
921.text: "Shutting down the House of Delegates is a prudent move under the current circumstances, and your assistance would be much appreciated."

922.speaker: Russello Montoro
922.text: "Great, Your Majesty. I'll be waiting for your signal."

923.speaker: Russello Montoro
923.text: "You change your mind, I'll be here by the phone."

924.speaker: Russello Montoro
924.text: "Just call me Rusty the Reliable. Or is that stealing your thing?"

925.speaker: Player_Romus
925.text: "Sounds great. I hope I can rely on you when the time comes."

927.speaker: Russello Montoro
927.text: "Believe it or not, my meteoric rise at RRG was not accomplished entirely on my lonesome."

928.speaker: Russello Montoro
928.text: "In exchange, I have occasionally allowed RRG to serve as a financial conduit between those partners and... various other parties."

929.speaker: Russello Montoro
929.text: "Early on in my career, certain international partners took note of my ambitions and offered their assistance."

930.speaker: Russello Montoro
930.text: "And one such set of transactions proves a definitive link between the country of Lespia and the little incident that derailed the return of Zille."

931.speaker: Player_Romus
931.text: "You have proof that Lespia was involved in the Friendship Day incident?"

932.speaker: Player_Romus
932.text: "So you're saying you've been working for Lespia behind my back this whole time?"

933.speaker: Player_Romus
933.text: "Were you complicit in the Wehlen bombing? Because if you were, lives are on your hands."

934.speaker: Russello Montoro
934.text: "I swear I had no idea what I was transferring to whom. It was shell corporations inside shell corporations..."

935.speaker: Russello Montoro
935.text: "But I knew enough to make backup copies of all the paperwork. It's all there for someone smarter than me to decipher."

936.speaker: Russello Montoro
936.text: "I'm pretty sure I do. I mean, it's shell corporations inside of shell corporations..."

937.speaker: Russello Montoro
937.text: "But it's all there for someone smarter than me to decipher."

938.speaker: Russello Montoro
938.text: "I'm not saying anything of the sort. What I'm trying to tell you is that my loyalties lie with Rizia and Rizia alone."

942.speaker: Player_Romus
942.text: "I already know Lespia was behind the bombing, Rusty. Your information means nothing to me."

944.speaker: Russello Montoro
944.text: "Then excuse my profanity, but why the heck haven't you done anything about it?"

945.speaker: Player_Romus
945.text: "How could you be stupid enough to admit this to me?"

946.speaker: Russello Montoro
946.text: "I wish I could, Your Majesty. But I can't just saunter out of my house and hand it to you."

947.speaker: Russello Montoro
947.text: "About half of my guards from Palantor are guys I trust. The others, well... I don't think they ever worked for me."

948.speaker: Russello Montoro
948.text: "If I do this for you, they'll never let me live. You've got to provide me with reinforcements."

949.speaker: Player_Romus
949.text: "I order you to deliver me whatever information you have on Lespia's involvement. Right this instant."

950.speaker: Player_Romus
950.text: "I don't want to upset Rizia's relations with Lespia. This so-called 'evidence' must never see the light of day."

954.speaker: Player_Romus
954.text: "I don't want our relations with Lespia to deteriorate further. This so-called 'evidence' must never see the light of day."

955.speaker: Russello Montoro
955.text: "Stupid? I'm taking a leap of faith here, Your Majesty."

956.speaker: Russello Montoro
956.text: "I'm willing to turn on Lespia and give you the break you need to get back Zille. All so you and I can keep pushing Rizia to economic greatness."

957.speaker: Player_Romus
957.text: "And what would you expect in return for this valuable piece of intel?"

958.speaker: Player_Romus
958.text: "That's not important. What matters is that you just admitted to the King of Rizia that you've been working for foreign interests."

959.speaker: Russello Montoro
959.text: "I've got the paperwork stashed somewhere safe. It's all there for someone smarter than me to decipher."

960.speaker: Russello Montoro
960.text: "Only that you and I keep pushing Rizia to economic greatness, Your Majesty."

961.speaker: Russello Montoro
961.text: "Well. And that the Crown protect me from whatever retaliation my ex-partners have in store."

962.speaker: Russello Montoro
962.text: "And that I am willing to use that work to further the interests of the Crown."

963.speaker: Player_Romus
963.text: "There's no way I can keep working with you now, Rusty. I have no choice but to place you under arrest for treason."

965.speaker: Narrator
965.text: I could practically hear him racking his brain over the phone.

966.speaker: Russello Montoro
966.text: "Listen, Your Majesty. There are benefits to me staying on ATO"s good side, too."

970.speaker: Player_Romus
970.text: "I destroyed the evidence I had as part of an agreement with Prime Minister Alvarez."

973.speaker: Russello Montoro
973.text: "Such agreements were made to be broken, Your Majesty. I'm exhibit A."

974.speaker: Russello Montoro
974.text: "Well, shit. And here I thought we had a good thing going."

975.speaker: Narrator
975.text: For the first time, I became aware of background noises on the other end of the phone. It sounded as if he was at an airport.

980.speaker: Russello Montoro
980.text: "You know that money you owe me? Consider that debt squared."

981.speaker: Player_Romus
981.text: "By the authority of the Crown, you are now a wanted man."

983.speaker: Player_Romus
983.text: "What?! Where do you think you're going?"

986.speaker: Player_Romus
986.text: "Might it be more advantageous for you to keep your cover? I can think of a few good uses for a mercenary force like Palantor."

987.speaker: Russello Montoro
987.text: "Heh. Your mind works in interesting ways, Your Majesty."

988.speaker: Russello Montoro
988.text: "But sure, Antoine and the boys have been complaining that it's been a while since they saw real action. I'm sure they'd be happy to pick up any tasks too dirty for your Golden Guard to touch."

989.speaker: Player_Romus
989.text: "Get me the evidence first. Then we'll talk about reinforcements."

990.speaker: Russello Montoro
990.text: "That's not how it works, Your Majesty..."

992.speaker: Russello Montoro
992.text: "I stick my neck out any further, they're going to get suspicious. In fact, I'm calling from my washroom right now."

998.speaker: Russello Montoro
998.text: "I knew you'd want in! I'm telling you, Your Majesty, this will be a game-changer."

999.speaker: Russello Montoro
999.text: "But you're sure you want to pass up the information I'm offering? It'll basically deliver Zille into our hands."

1000.speaker: Russello Montoro
1000.text: "Antoine and the boys of Palantor have been complaining that it's been a while since they saw real action. I'm sure they'd be happy to pick up any tasks too dirty for your Golden Guard to touch."

1001.speaker: Player_Romus
1001.text: "A mercenary force that can't be connected to the Crown or any noble houses... yes, that might prove useful when the time comes."

1002.speaker: Russello Montoro
1002.text: "Right? You'll be as good as untouchable."

1003.speaker: Player_Romus
1003.text: "Thanks, but no thanks. Our business partnership will stay as it is. I'm going to forget this entire conversation."

1004.speaker: Player_Romus
1004.text: "You can't weasel your way out of this one, Rusty. You just admitted you're a traitor to the Crown. I have no choice but to put you under arrest."

1007.speaker: Player_Romus
1007.text: "All right. Get me your evidence and the Crown will spare no expense in contracting a new guard force for you." [-1 Budget]

1008.speaker: Player_Romus
1008.text: "Send over everything you have on Lespia and I will send troops  to guarantee your safety." [-200 Manpower]

1017.speaker: Russello Montoro
1017.text: "Thank you so much, Your Majesty. I promise you I'll deliver."

1019.speaker: Player_Romus
1019.text: "I don't need that evidence to get Zille."

1020.speaker: Player_Romus
1020.text: "That paperwork is a liability. Destroy it at once."

1024.speaker: Player_Romus
1024.text: "Thinking it over, it is a tempting proposition... And I do have the resources to protect you from Lespia's retaliation."

1028.speaker: Player_Romus
1028.text: "I changed my mind. It's too much risk for an uncertain reward."

1029.speaker: Russello Montoro
1029.text: "Hey, no problem. I was just offering my assistance."

1030.speaker: Russello Montoro
1030.text: "My guys and I will be around if you ever need us."

1035.speaker: Russello Montoro
1035.text: "I'll be around if you ever need me."

1036.speaker: Russello Montoro
1036.text: "You don't have to tell me twice. Will do."

1037.speaker: Player_Romus
1037.text: "It's a tempting proposition, but I don't have the resources to protect you from Lespia's retaliation."

1039.speaker: Player_Romus
1039.text: "One more thing. The House of Delegates has been getting in my way of late. Can you assist me in doing away with it?"

1043.speaker: Russello Montoro
1043.text: "Just call me Rusty the Reliable. Or is that stealing your thing?"

1044.speaker: Player_Romus
1044.text: "On second thought, that seems like overkill."

1045.speaker: Russello Montoro
1045.text: "With my connections, I can make sure the nobles who hold Delegate seats are compensated for their sudden unemployment."

1046.speaker: Russello Montoro
1046.text: "And in the case any ex-members start feeling litigious, they'll find every legal expert in the kingdom mysteriously occupied."

1047.speaker: Player_Romus
1047.text: "Shutting down the House of Delegates is a prudent move under the current circumstances, and your assistance would be much appreciated."

1048.speaker: Russello Montoro
1048.text: "Great, Your Majesty. I'll be waiting for your signal."

1049.speaker: Russello Montoro
1049.text: "You change your mind, I'll be here by the phone."

1050.speaker: Player_Romus
1050.text: "Sounds great. I hope I can rely on you when the time comes."

1063.text: Still holding the receiver, I dialed Lucita and ordered her to place Russello Montoro under special protection.

1069.speaker: Narrator
1069.text: Lespia would answer for its crimes.

1071.speaker: Russello Montoro
1071.text: "I can get it to you. Maybe not in time for your chat with Smolak, but soon enough."

1072.speaker: Russello Montoro
1072.text: "I can get it to you. Maybe not in time for your chat with Smolak, but soon."

1073.speaker: Russello Montoro
1073.text: "I can get it to you. It'll take a while, but I can do it."

1077.speaker: Player_Romus
1077.text: "So you're saying you've been working for Lespia behind my back this whole time?"

1078.speaker: Russello Montoro
1078.text: "I'm not saying anything of the sort. What I'm trying to tell you is that my loyalties lie with Rizia and Rizia alone. And I'll prove it."

1079.speaker: Player_Romus
1079.text: "We know all that already. Did you know Lespia was trying to undermine us?"

1080.speaker: Russello Montoro
1080.text: "I swear I had no idea. But get this, Your Majesty..."

1081.speaker: Russello Montoro
1081.text: "I can get it to you. Not before your meeting with Smolak, but in time to stick it to Lespia later."

1082.speaker: Russello Montoro
1082.text: "I can get it to you. Not before your meeting with Smolak, but in time to stick it to Lespia later."

1101.speaker: Narrator
1101.text: Rusty's treason would go unpunished. But Lespia would answer for its crimes.

1102.speaker: Narrator
1102.text: Rusty's treason would go unpunished. But I had secured his loyalty for life.

1104.speaker: Russello Montoro
1104.text: "On that subject, I couldn't be more excited about our new stock exchange. You made the right call there."

1111.speaker: Russello Montoro
1111.text: "On that subject, I couldn't be more excited about our new stock exchange. But not naming me chair? Big missed opportunity."

1112.speaker: Russello Montoro
1112.text: "Did Werner tell you about our stock exchange idea yet? I'm telling you, we could be raking it in for years to come."

1115.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1115.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.HODElection_RustyInfluence_RNC"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.HODElection_RustyInfluence_RPP"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_LoanAmount"] > 0) == false

1116.speaker: Player_Romus
1116.text: "After all you've done for me, it was a no-brainer."

1118.speaker: Russello Montoro
1118.text: "Don't think too long. The market waits for no man."

1123.speaker: Russello Montoro
1123.text: "So is this new vanilla-flavored synthetic whipped topping they've just come out with. Don't mean my fridge isn't full of it."

1125.speaker: Russello Montoro
1125.text: "Don't you get it, Your Majesty? We're in this together. 'Least, I thought we were."

1126.speaker: Player_Romus
1126.text: "This is a gamble on Rizia's part. I'm counting on you not to let your kingdom down."

1127.speaker: Player_Romus
1127.text: "I hope that my generosity will be reciprocated."

1128.speaker: Russello Montoro
1128.text: "A true capitalist in the making. I couldn't be prouder of you."

1129.speaker: Player_Romus
1129.text: "I believe I've done quite enough for you."

1133.speaker: Russello Montoro
1133.text: "Hey, this wouldn't have just benefited me, you know. We're in this together. Or I thought we were."

1134.speaker: Player_Romus
1134.text: "I'll make it up to you at some point."

1136.speaker: Player_Romus
1136.text: "A brilliant idea. Once I get the resources together, I will implement it."

1138.speaker: Player_Romus
1138.text: "Who are you to be complaining? Count yourself lucky the exchange was even founded."

1141.speaker: Russello Montoro
1141.text: "Nah, we both know you didn't have to name me chair. I'm grateful for the show of faith in me."

1150.speaker: Russello Montoro
1150.text: "If you don't mind my asking, what's a nice king like you need a mean old task force like Palantor for?"

1154.speaker: Player_Romus
1154.text: "There is a certain former RRG miner who has become quite the fly in the royal ointment, if you get my drift."

1155.speaker: Russello Montoro
1155.text: "Sotelato. Yeah, our Lespian friends don't like him either."

1156.speaker: Russello Montoro
1156.text: "I'm sure Antoine and the boys will be eager to offer their assistance in that department."

1157.speaker: Russello Montoro
1157.text: "Not tomorrow. But if you and I work together, get him in the right place at the right time... he'll be a goner."

1158.speaker: Player_Romus
1158.text: "The time will soon come when I have to convince Rizia to accept certain changes to its government. I may make use of their persuasive abilities then."
1158.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Religion_Leaning_Theocratic"] == true)

1160.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1160.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Religion_Leaning_Theocratic"] == true)

1161.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1161.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Religion_Leaning_Theocratic"] == true)) == false

1162.speaker: Player_Romus
1162.text: "The time may come when I am forced to eliminate my rivals. I may make use of their persuasive abilities then."
1162.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Religion_Leaning_Theocratic"] == true)) == false

1163.speaker: Russello Montoro
1163.text: "Whatever you want. Just say the word."

1165.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1165.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn07_Intention_HODShutdown"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.LeaningValue_Democratic"] < 0  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_TyrantKing"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Stratocracy_HODAssistanceOffered"] == false

1166.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1166.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn07_Intention_HODShutdown"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.LeaningValue_Democratic"] < 0  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_TyrantKing"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Stratocracy_HODAssistanceOffered"] == false) == false

1167.speaker: Player_Romus
1167.text: "On second thought, that seems like overkill."

1168.speaker: Russello Montoro
1168.text: "With my connections, I can make sure the nobles who hold Delegate seats are compensated for their sudden unemployment."

1169.speaker: Russello Montoro
1169.text: "And in the case any RPP members start feeling litigious, they'll find every legal expert in the kingdom mysteriously occupied."

1170.speaker: Player_Romus
1170.text: "Shutting down the House of Delegates is a prudent move under the current circumstances, and your assistance would be much appreciated."

1171.speaker: Russello Montoro
1171.text: "Great, Your Majesty. I'll be waiting for your signal."

1172.speaker: Russello Montoro
1172.text: "You change your mind, I'll be here by the phone."

1173.speaker: Russello Montoro
1173.text: "Just call me Rusty the Reliable. Or is that stealing your thing?"

1174.speaker: Player_Romus
1174.text: "Sounds great. I hope I can rely on you when the time comes."

1177.speaker: Player_Romus
1177.text: "The House of Delegates has been getting in my way of late. Can you help me shut it down?"
1177.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_LoanAmount"] > 0) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn07_Intention_HODShutdown"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.LeaningValue_Democratic"] < 0  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_TyrantKing"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Stratocracy_HODAssistanceOffered"] == false)

1180.speaker: Player_Romus
1180.text: "You'll say anything when your life is on the line, won't you?"

1189.speaker: Player_Romus
1189.text: "We are on a journey to return to the days when our land gained the title of the Golden Kingdom."

1190.speaker: Russello Montoro
1190.text: "There is potential, indeed. Were it not for the war, prosperity could have matched that of the early 1900s."

1191.speaker: Player_Romus
1191.text: "Let me guess. You think you could make our strong economy even stronger?"

1192.speaker: Russello Montoro
1192.text: "Resources mean nothing without reach. Rizia should own the trade routes, the markets, the conversation itself."

1196.speaker: Player_Romus
1196.text: "There is plenty of work ahead of us, I'm open to include you in the future."

1197.speaker: Russello Montoro
1197.text: "I am a son of Rizia. I’ll do my best to keep it on the right path."
